results.title: Former Ballboy Charlie Morgan, Kicked by Eden Hazard in 2013, Set for £100m Payout From £500m Vodka Sale
results.description: Charlie Morgan, once a viral ballboy, co-founded Au Vodka, now in talks for a £500m sale. The deal could net him over £100m, marking a remarkable business journey.

results.title: WTA Cincinnati Open 2026 Results: Iga Swiatek Crushes Emiliana Arango As Aryna Sabalenka, Coco Gauff, Elena Rybakina Advance
results.description: Iga Swiatek opened her Cincinnati Open 2026 title defence with a 6-3, 6-0 win over Emiliana Arango, while Aryna Sabalenka, Coco Gauff, Elena Rybakina and Mirra Andreeva also advanced in Cincinnati. results.title: Werrimull win a week off
results.description: WERRIMULL stunned A Grade minor premiers Bambill on Saturday at the Cardross Recreation Reserve courts and now get a week off before facing either the Saints or reigning premiers Nangiloc on their home deck in the grand final down at the Lake. While not utterly unexpected, Bambill went into the qualifying final encounter heavy favourites [...]
